text:
I would like to thank this group who help me all through out! Specially the admins & members. 🥰

Sharing our process and timeline for those who are currently on process too. (Married couple) MH ~ TLV BRANCH. ❤️❤️❤️

Im currently living in israel, working as a foreign worker. 

November 28, 2024 - we got married

December 25, 2024 - we completed the 
documents and submit to misrad thru online
 (TLV BRANCH) 

July 26, 2025 - they call us to come to the office and suddenly no interview at all they just give my b1 unrestricted to my passport and give the next schedule for upgrading b1 unrestricted to A5 on... march 05, 2026

March 05, 2026 - now we had a war, they just wrote me on my phone that no need to come to office because of the war they extended me 3 months until July 05, 2026 

May 18, 2026 - they call us to Misrad for the interview on that day 
Little bit story about my interview 😂🥲😌(unfortunately on my interview they dont have a translator so i speak hebrew one on one, and it just came out of nowhere that i can speak hebrew suddenly! 🤣 maybe just my adrenaline because they ask me if they want to move the interview when there will be availabe 😅

(no call after that just once it was june 10 that we pass the a5 and we have schedule on june 22)

June 22, 2026 -  we went there & they put my sticker on my passport & did biometrics.

And now today JULY 09, 2026 in the the morning they deliever it to our apartment and i recieved my physical ID. 🪪 

MH TLV BRANCH IS good my husband just visit once to follow up the rest they just calling us all the way. It was very smooth, the staff are very friendly, the process went good we are quiet and just waiting for a call. And oh one more thing the woman who was holding our case in b1 is not the same the one who interview us, and its another woman again when we recieved the a5. (Now we dont know who is really holding our case!😅😃)

To everyone who is currently on process never loose hope, and im just sharing it because im happy & maybe this could help like me before as a silent reader here! ❤️ godbless everyone & goodluck!

Btw I am (FILIPINA + israeli AZERBAIJAN couple)
